l.i: peccatorum: Et rursus Epist. 106. Posse nos per
fidem mereri Gratiam bene operandi.— Ego sa-
nè possem ad eundem Augustinum sexcentis in
locis provocare; in quibus tuetur, Justificationem
inchoari, sed nè absolvi quidem: ut Epist. 105.
Qua igitur sua merita jactaturus est Liberatus?
qui, si digna suis meritis redderentur, non esset nisi
& irrefragabile judicium. Etiam Concil. Trident. Sess.6.

main_text.l: (inquit) quia nihil eorum, quæ justificationem præcedunt, sive

promeretur — alioquin, ut idem Apostolus, Gratia
non esset Gratia. Pòst arguit, Arbitramur

page.notes: Only one marginal note, at top right, marked §. The leading marks before "Qua igitur" and "Arbitramur" look like ornamental section marks, not reference marks, and are left out; they are uncertain. Italic and roman boundaries in the long paragraph are read from the scan and may be slightly off. "Benius" in the note is read as printed and may be a misreading. Faint show-through text from the other side of the leaf is ignored. The running head is read as "Sect 2." and the "2." may be slightly different in the original.
